evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫（Chinese University of Hong Kong）
evidence.text: The entry reports a laugh-related use of 笑 in the Mawangdui Laozi B preceding text, section 稱, line 152: 「實穀不華，至言不飾，至樂不笑。」 This is a dictionary-reported manuscript use; the passage’s exact physical graph has not been inspected here.
evidence.title: 漢語多功能字庫: 笑

evidence.source: Antiquities and Monuments Office, Hong Kong
evidence.field: Silk manuscript of Yinyang Wuxing, Article B: period and provenance
evidence.text: The collection record identifies a Mawangdui Tomb M3 silk manuscript as Western Han and says it was unearthed there in 1973. This supports Western Han dating for the Tomb 3 manuscript context, but does not by itself establish the date or graph of the specific Laozi B passage reported by CUHK.
evidence.title: Silk manuscript of Yinyang Wuxing (Yinyang and the Five Elements) Article B

search_audit.query: Mawangdui Tomb 3 manuscript Western Han museum collection dating Laozi B manuscript; site:amo.gov.hk Mawangdui Tomb M3 manuscript Western Han; Mawangdui Laozi B manuscript date Tomb 3 official museum
search_audit.outcome: Search located a museum collection record identifying a manuscript from Mawangdui Tomb M3 as Western Han, plus a CUHK dictionary page reporting 笑 in Mawangdui Laozi B line 152. Opened and inspected the museum and CUHK pages. The museum record establishes Tomb 3 context, not the exact passage’s graph or manuscript dating.

gaps: The Mawangdui laugh-sense example should be described as a reported use in a Mawangdui manuscript, without assigning a period to the particular passage unless separately supported. A museum record dates a different Tomb 3 silk manuscript to the Western Han and provides context only; the exact Laozi B passage and its graph were not inspected.
The first physical attestation of 笑 and the exact form in the reported Mawangdui passage remain unverified.
